extracted.name: Spicy Refrigerator Dill Pickles
extracted.description: Spicy pickles with a hint of sweetness. This recipe is great for pickling beginners — all you need is a refrigerator, a few jars, and patience.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 teaspoon red pepper flakes, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine cucumbers, water, vinegar, chopped dill, sugar, garlic, salt, pickling spice, dill seed, and red pepper flakes in a large bowl. Stir and let sit at room temperature until sugar and salt dissolve, about 2 hours.

Transfer cucumbers to 3 wide-mouth, 1 1/2-pint jars, placing 4 cucumbers into each jar. Add enough vinegar mixture to cover cucumbers. Place 1 sprig of fresh dill into each jar and seal with lids. Refrigerate for 10 days before eating. Use within 1 month.
